title: Customize Your Privacy NOW (privacy.sexy)
description:
privacy.sexy is an awesome website for creating custom privacy scripts. It is also great to see some of the many ways each OS spies on you.

This open-source website runs hundreds of scripts to kill telemetry, strip bloatware, and lock down Windows, macOS, and Linux. The script is transparent to you from the beginning, and you can cut/paste with ease.

This site is free and built for people who actually want to understand what they're disabling and why. If you're serious about offensive security, remember that your attack surface starts with your own system. 

For educational purposes only.
